judgments.supporting_quote: A potential failure is an identifiable condition that indicates that a functional failure is either about to occur or is in the process of occurring.
Interphase reactors and transformers ... are to be provided with a high temperature alarm at the switchboard or the propulsion control station.
The pump internals ... must be filled with the fluid to be handled at all times. Provide sufficient inlet pressure.
Make sure that the Connex pin (8) onto the the stub shaft is inserted into the notch in the drive ring (10)
Some Bronze FIP can be supplied with Clutches attached.
Collect and properly dispose of flushing fluid and any residues of the fluid handled.
Use a proper puller to remove the bearings from the pump shaft.
The system is to be tried under working condition in the presence of a Surveyor
